newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ SPORT - Cricket squad named for Zimbabwe tour.
newsitem.headline: NZ SPORT - Cricket squad named for Zimbabwe tour.

text.p: New Zealand cricket on Wednesday announced a 17-man squad to prepare for the tour of Zimbabwe in September and October.
The squad will be trimmed to 14 before the tourists leave for southern Africa in early September.
Otago offspinner Paul Wiseman is a new addition to the senior national squad. He replaces Dipak Patel, 38, who announced his retirement after almost a decade at international level.

Squad: Stephen Fleming (captain), Bryan Young, Blair Pocock, Nathan Astle, Chris Cairns, Adam Parore, Craig McMillan, Daniel Vettori, Gavin Larsen, Heath Davis, Simon Doull, Geoff Allott, Paul Wiseman, Chris Harris, Matt Horne, Shayne O'Connor, Andrew Penn.
